subject: gk
question:
Consider the following statements:

Statement I: Land and agriculture fall under the State List.

Statement II: Marriage laws and adoption fall under the Concurrent List.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?

options.text: Both statements I and II are correct
Neither statement I nor II is correct

solution:
The correct answer is __**Both statements I and II are correct**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Statement I:** Land and agriculture are included in the **State List** as per the Seventh Schedule of the Indian Constitution. This means state governments have exclusive powers to legislate on these matters.
